_meta._note: Chapter 60, Lesson 4 (ch60-l04 converted in place to the CL16 Conversation Lab). A (helper) and B (traveller): ask whether this bus goes to Makkah, ask where it stands, thank the helper, and correct his wrong restatement ('To Madinah, correct?'). The scene facts are written out (bus A is labelled Madinah, bus B Makkah and stands in front of the station) so every reply can be checked; a fresh exercise changes the facts so copying the model's 'no' fails. أَمَامَ and الْمَحَطَّةِ are taught in the pattern card; مَكَّةَ is supplied whole. No ritual ruling, route or timing is taught. Nine phrases, four mission turns, eight exercises. The phrase clips are listed in Docs/lesson-audio-needed.md; none is generated. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 7 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-60-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.
